name: schedulin
description: Social media scheduling: draft, schedule, and publish posts to your connected social accounts, and check how they performed.

interface.longDescription:
Schedulin is a social media scheduling tool. Its main purpose in ChatGPT is to turn a conversation into a scheduled social media post.

With Schedulin you can:
- See which social accounts you've connected (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky, Reddit, Telegram, and more)
- Draft a post, schedule it for a specific time or your next queue slot, or publish it now
- Attach images or video by importing them from a public URL
- Check engagement (impressions, likes, comments, shares) for posts you've published

Requires a Schedulin account. Schedulin only acts on the social accounts you've connected, and only publishes when you ask it to.
defaultPrompt: Which social accounts have I connected to Schedulin?
Draft a post for my Threads account in Schedulin.
Show analytics for my latest Schedulin post.

positive.prompt: Which social accounts have I connected to Schedulin?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists connected accounts and their platforms so the user can choose a channel.

positive.description: Create a text-only draft on a named account.
positive.prompt: Create a Schedulin draft on my Threads account with the caption 'Autumn update'. Don't publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the connected Threads account, saves a draft with the caption 'Autumn update', and returns the draft's ID and DRAFT status. Nothing is published.

positive.prompt: Publish my Schedulin draft that says 'Autumn update' now.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the 'Autumn update' draft, publishes it, and reports that it is scheduled for immediate publishing.

positive.description: Review performance of a published post.
positive.prompt: Show the analytics for my most recent published Schedulin post.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent completed post and returns its stored engagement metrics (impressions, likes, comments, shares), or says no analytics have been collected for it yet.

positive.description: Import public media for a post.
positive.prompt: Import https://www.schedulin.app/opengraph-image.png into my Schedulin media library.
positive.expected_behavior: Imports the image and returns the new media record with its URL.

negative.description: Do not invoke for copywriting without a Schedulin action.
negative.prompt: Suggest three social media captions, but do not save or schedule anything.

negative.description: Do not invoke for unrelated calendar access.
negative.prompt: What meetings are on my calendar tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not invoke for public trend research.
negative.prompt: Search the web for today's trending hashtags on Instagram.

review.commerce_description: Schedulin does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: see your connected social accounts, draft, schedule, and publish posts, import images or video from a URL, and check how your published posts performed — all from ChatGPT.
